study type: Prospective cohort study with a case-control design
cohort: The study included 20 singleton preterm pregnancies with PPROM and 20 uncomplicated, gestational age-matched control pregnancies.
finding: Maternal blood endotoxin activity (EA) was significantly elevated at admission in women with PPROM compared to controls, and a significant drop in EA was noted in PPROM cases with longer latency to delivery (>7 days) compared to those delivering within 7 days.
gest_age: Mean gestational age for PPROM cases was 29.0 ± 2.2 weeks, with controls being gestational age-matched.
